### Weekly Product Pulse — 2026-10-20
**Evidence:** 512 entries in a 12-week window; 425 unclassified. Convenience sample, not representative.
**Top three themes:** Usage limits & upsell (35/512); Answer accuracy (19/512); Subscription billing & refunds (16/512).
**Three verbatim excerpts:**
- “I just sent a few pictures and then it wouldn't let me continue, even though I was in” — APPLE_14684835197, 2026-10-19 [source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/chatgpt/id6448311069?see-all=reviews&reviewId=14684835197)
- “It makes a lot of mistakes now!!!” — APPLE_14684382677, 2026-10-18 [source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/chatgpt/id6448311069?see-all=reviews&reviewId=14684382677)
- “I dint see any difference so i believe their subscription is pointless specially for 22$ a month but” — APPLE_14680607843, 2026-10-18 [source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/chatgpt/id6448311069?see-all=reviews&reviewId=14680607843)
**Fee signal:** Renewal/cancellation and refund confusion recurs in 3 reviews APPLE_14680607843, R010, R011. Reports do not establish billing defects.
**Recommended actions:**
1. Clarify renewal timing and cancellation in subscription settings.
2. Publish platform-specific refund guidance.
3. Track billing support contacts weekly to evaluate improvement.
identified_fee_issue: ChatGPT subscription renewal charges and cancellation/refund expectations
explanation_bullets: ChatGPT subscriptions may be billed through chatgpt.com, Apple App Store, or Google Play; the purchase platform manages cancellation.
Subscriptions can renew unless canceled before the next billing date; OpenAI recommends canceling at least 24 hours beforehand.
Removing the mobile app does not cancel an active subscription.
Canceling stops future renewals but does not automatically refund a previous charge.
For web or Google Play purchases, request a refund through OpenAI Support while signed into the charged account; Apple purchases are handled by Apple.
Refund eligibility depends on the purchase and applicable policies or legal rights; approval is not guaranteed.
